text:
ava: quick heads-up — PR #19765 is hitting intermittent failures in the integ suite on shard 12 (TimeoutError). Can we coordinate a targeted rerun and decide whether a snapshot update is needed?
ci-bot: build failed on linux-integ-shard12 — failing test: `TestWorker::test_cleanup_timeout`
```
AssertionError: expected 0 tasks, found 1
  at TestWorker.test_cleanup_timeout (tests/worker/test_cleanup.py:42)
  timeout after 5.0s
```
mike: I can reproduce ~1 in 20 locally. Looks like a race on teardown, not related to model code.
sophia: @mike @elaine — can we get approval to do a targeted rerun (only the failing test / shard) and a plan for snapshot update if diffs are minimal? :eyes: 
mike: fine by me. prefer: auto-retry 3 times across different pools first, then decide. avoid snapshot churn unless necessary.
elaine: quick question — does this change any user-facing behavior? I don't think so. :thumbsup:
ava: proposed plan: 1) run 3 targeted retries across pool-a/pool-b/pool-c; 2) if >=2/3 pass, allow merge; 3) if >=2/3 fail, open follow-up bug and opt for snapshot update only after triage. @sophia confirm?
sophia: confirm. also suggest a small timeout bump in the flaky test (5s -> 8s) as a follow-up if it keeps popping up. I can add a one-line test PR after this merges.
ava: noted. who will approve the PR after green? @mike?
mike: I'll approve after green and scan for new regressions. :eyes:
ci-bot: targeted rerun scheduled: rerun_id=rr-8832 pools=[pool-a,pool-b,pool-c] ETA ~12m
ava: thanks — I'll check back in ~20m with results.
[20 minutes later]
ci-bot: rerun rr-8832 completed: results: pool-a=pass, pool-b=pass, pool-c=fail. summary: 2/3 passed; failing run shows same assertion and small diff in teardown timing.
ava: update: 2/3 pass so per plan it's safe to merge pending reviewer approval. I'll open BUG-4387 for the persistent pool-c failure so we track it.
mike: looked at the logs — seems like an ephemeral race in cleanup; okay to merge and track BUG-4387 separately. approving now. :thumbsup:
sophia: approving as well. go ahead and merge.
ava: merging now. post-merge full CI will run; I'll monitor the pipeline. thanks all.
ci-bot: merge queued by ava; merge_id=m-7721. post-merge CI triggered.
elaine: leaving a short note in the PR with rerun summary and BUG-4387 link.
ava: done, added rerun summary + BUG-4387. closing thread.
